initializeResponse.instructions:
This server controls DeepSeek Harness (DSH) sessions through the DSH ACP profile.
Typical flow: dsh_create_session -> dsh_send_message -> dsh_close_session (or dsh_delete_session to remove the persisted session).
Every conversation starts at dsh_create_session: the bridge does not list or resume existing sessions, and it never reads or replays prior transcripts.
Always pass an explicit session_id; the bridge never assumes "the most recent session".
DSH tool permission requests are denied unless permission_policy="allow_once" is passed explicitly.
DSH internal thoughts are not returned unless the bridge operator enabled DSH_CODEX_INCLUDE_THOUGHTS.

tools.name: dsh_create_session
tools.title: Create a DSH session
tools.description: Create a fresh persistent DSH session via ACP session/new. cwd must be absolute, inside the configured allowlist, and is realpath-canonicalised before use. model / reasoning_effort are only accepted when explicitly allowlisted by the bridge. Every conversation starts here: the bridge does not list or resume existing sessions.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory for the new session.

model.description: Optional model id; must be allowlisted (DSH_CODEX_ALLOWED_MODELS).

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort; must be allowlisted (DSH_CODEX_ALLOWED_REASONING_EFFORTS).

profile.description: Optional DSH profile; must equal the bridge profile.

tools.name: dsh_send_message
tools.title: Send a message to a DSH session
tools.description: Send one user text message to a session created by this bridge process via ACP session/prompt and wait for the turn to settle. Exactly one prompt may be in flight per session. Returns the assistant text, a tool-call summary and usage. DSH internal thoughts (agent_thought_chunk) are NOT returned unless the operator set DSH_CODEX_INCLUDE_THOUGHTS. Permission requests made by DSH tools are DENIED unless permission_policy is explicitly "allow_once"; they are never auto-approved.

session_id.description: Explicit session id returned by dsh_create_session.

permission_policy.description: How to answer DSH tool permission requests for this turn.

timeout_ms.description: Prompt settlement timeout; capped by the bridge prompt timeout.

tools.name: dsh_cancel_session
tools.title: Cancel a DSH session run
tools.description: Ask the ACP session/cancel method to stop the work of exactly one session. The in-flight prompt settles with stopReason "cancelled"; other sessions are untouched.

tools.name: dsh_close_session
tools.title: Close a DSH session
tools.description: Close exactly one session via ACP session/close. This cancels in-flight work, drains updates, flushes persistence, and releases the session run scope. Persisted storage is retained (the bridge offers no resume, so the session becomes dormant). Requires confirm=true. Closing is NOT read-only and is NOT a safe way to inspect a session; it will cancel that session's in-flight work.

confirm.description: Must be true: closing cancels in-flight work and releases run resources (it is not read-only).

tools.name: dsh_delete_session
tools.title: Delete a DSH session (local storage)
tools.description: Permanently delete the local persisted storage of a session CREATED BY THIS BRIDGE PROCESS. DSH ACP has no session/delete method, so this removes the session directory under DSH_HOME/sessions directly; it is the only way to remove one. A still-active session is closed first (requires sessionCapabilities.close). Requires confirm=true. Sessions created by the desktop app or by a previous bridge process are refused; run scripts/prune-sessions.ts for explicit manual cleanup.

session_id.description: Explicit session id created by this bridge process.

confirm.description: Must be true: deleting permanently removes the session's local persisted files (cannot be undone).
